reviews.text:
The Glass Guru really impressed me. I’d been checking around with a few places and kept running into high prices or slow responses, but Chris, Ivan, and Hailey were on top of it from the start. They were clear, straightforward, and actually made the whole process easy.

Everything felt organized and handled the right way — no back and forth, no headaches. They just showed up, did solid work, and delivered exactly what they promised.

If you’re looking for a reliable team that doesn’t overcomplicate things, The Glass Guru is definitely worth calling.
reviews.author: Chris Malone

reviews.text:
Absolutely outstanding service from The Glass Guru off Mockingbird! Chris, Ivan, and Hailey were incredible from start to finish. Their pricing beat every other quote I received — I saved over $5,000 and avoided months of waiting.

The installation was unbelievably fast. The team showed up on time, worked efficiently, and had everything installed in under 30 minutes. The quality is top-tier, and the whole process was smooth and stress-free.

If you need glass work done, don’t waste time shopping around — this team is the real deal. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Elizabeth Malone

reviews.text: I had a spontaneous breakage in my front door glass. This is a large iron door that was custom made. I called the company where I purchased the the door and was given a time frame of 6 months for replacement. Obviously unacceptable. The Glass Guru tech Ivan came out and estimated a replacement could be installed in 5 days. True to his word Ivan came out and fixed my problem in a timely and professional manner. The repair was perfect and the door looks like new. Highly recommend this company!
reviews.author: Kevin Hunter

reviews.text: Quick and easy. They measured one day and two days later they replaced my broken window pain and under 30 minutes.
reviews.author: David Harrel

reviews.text: I called yesterday and they came today and replaced two  windows.  Ivan did a great job!

data.summary: Customer reviews appear largely authentic with specific, credible details. The low Glassdoor score suggests potential internal issues not reflected in customer service. The two 'Malone' reviews from the same month are a minor anomaly but not definitive proof of fakery.
fake_signals: Two reviews from 'Malone' posted same month with similar praise
authentic_signals: Specific project details (custom iron door, window panes)
Mention of employee names (Chris, Ivan, Hailey)
Varied writing styles and specific outcomes (saved $5k, 30-minute install)
Consistent high ratings across Google and Angi
complaint_patterns: No specific customer complaints found in provided data
data.discrepancy_explanation: High customer ratings (Google 4.8, Angi 4.7) contrast with low employee rating (Glassdoor 2.5). No Yelp rating data found. BBB rating is high but reflects accreditation, not service quality.
